question: At the exact existing W1 and W2 endpoints, which ordered-top3 chain stage accounts for fixed N1's expected-log-loss advantage or disadvantage versus fixed C1: rank 1, rank 2 conditional on rank 1, rank 3 conditional on ranks 1-2, or a signed combination?
rationale: Q-REL-STRENGTH-1 found stable N1 advantage already at W1/relation_strength=0.0. The next diagnostic must explain that result without adding seeds, kernels, models or post-hoc slices. Exact chain-rule decomposition of the same joint cross-entropy is additive, exhaustive and does not alter any scientific object.

scope_basis.allowed_class: Digital Twin W0-W4 synthetic stress and failure diagnostics; C0/C1/N1 comparison only inside those synthetic worlds

decomposition_definition.identity: rank1 + rank2 + rank3 equals expected ordered-top3 joint log loss exactly up to floating tolerance
decomposition_definition.delta: N1 minus C1 at each rank; negative means N1 contributes lower cross-entropy at that rank

invariants: C1 and N1 rank-1 marginal predictions must remain equal within 1e-12.
Rank-1 N1-minus-C1 expected cross-entropy delta must therefore be zero within 1e-12 for W1 and W2.
Per-model decomposed total must match direct joint expected log loss within 1e-12.
No probability mass error may exceed 1e-10.

prespecified_W1_classification_rule.W1_GAIN_WITH_OFFSETTING_MIX: Total < 0 but neither of the prior signed patterns applies because of numerical/tie edge conditions. Report raw deltas and do not alter thresholds.

prespecified_W2_classification_rule: Apply the same signed rank2/rank3 classification vocabulary with W2_ prefix.
primary_outputs: W1 and W2 aggregate joint N1-minus-C1
W1 and W2 aggregate rank1/rank2/rank3 N1-minus-C1 contributions
the same contributions by fixed seed block
stopping_rule: Run this exact W1/W2 chain decomposition only. Do not add relation-event subgroups, rider slices, topology slices, new worlds, new seeds, model ablations or coefficient changes after seeing results. Any such follow-up requires separate prespecification and scope check.
interpretation_limits: The decomposition identifies where Synthetic predictive cross-entropy differences arise, not why real keirin behaves that way.
A W1 rank2/rank3 gain may reflect conditional information recovery under synthetic hidden-state misspecification and is not by itself proof of explicit real-world conditional line dependence.
No model selection, freeze, promotion, real-world edge, ROI or untouched-validation claim is authorized.
